data.gender_notes: Sharunikaa is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sharunikaa is a name derived from the Sanskrit and Tamil languages, meaning 'Goddess of Love and Prosperity'. This name is a combination of 'Sharu' which means 'Goddess' and 'Nikaa' which means 'Prosperity'. It is believed that Sharunikaa is a symbol of love, loyalty, and prosperity. The name Sharunikaa carries the meaning “Goddess of Love and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sharunikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharunikaa is a divine name that signifies the presence and blessings of the Goddess of Love and Prosperity. It is believed that the name bestows blessings of love, happiness, and prosperity on the bearer.
data.etymology: Sharunikaa belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharunikaa total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
